mentions.name: freethoughts
mentions.description: This AI-assisted tool supports critical thinking while reading and annotating documents, inspired by an unreleased Microsoft research demo shown in a TED talk. It was built over a weekend as a way to practice working with AI agents.
mentions.problem: AI tools risk killing critical thinking; this aims to sharpen it instead of replacing it.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://github.com/tannn/freethoughts

Inspired by a TED talk I saw [0] where the researcher from Microsoft displayed a program with AI assisting with thinking while someone was reading and annotating a document. They claimed it was a way to sharpen critical thinking instead of killing it.
